sections.title: 20th Century American Art Seminar: Art, Affect, and the Ends of Psychoanalysis
sections.description: This seminar examines the history of art, artists, and artistic movements that emerged in the United States during the twentieth century. It may also engage with histories of visual culture, criticism, and the theory of art. Specific topics vary from semester to semester.
